from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout(
            "The Universal Ratio: Reynolds Number (Re)",
            [
                "Re is the ratio of inertia to viscosity.",
                "High velocity and scale overcome the fluid's stickiness.",
                "This constant dictates if a turbulent structure emerges."
            ]
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        
        # Formula: Re = Inertia / Viscosity
        # Inertia in yellow (#FFFF00), Viscosity in green (#00FF00)
        re_tex = MathTex("Re", "=", "\\frac{\\text{Inertia}}{\\text{Viscosity}}", font_size=36)
        re_tex.set_color_by_tex("Inertia", YELLOW)
        re_tex.set_color_by_tex("Viscosity", GREEN)
        
        self.place_in_area(re_tex, 'A2', 'B5', scale_factor=1.2)
        self.play(Write(re_tex))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(YELLOW)
        )

        # Tug-of-War Visual
        # Yellow rope (Inertia) pulling against Green rope (Viscosity)
        
        tug_of_war_base = VGroup()
        yellow_side = Line(LEFT * 2, ORIGIN, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=8)
        green_side = Line(ORIGIN, RIGHT * 2, color=GREEN, stroke_width=8)
        center_knot = Dot(color=WHITE, radius=0.15)
        
        inertia_label = Text("Inertia", font_size=20, color=YELLOW).next_to(yellow_side, UP)
        viscosity_label = Text("Viscosity", font_size=20, color=GREEN).next_to(green_side, UP)
        
        tug_group = VGroup(yellow_side, green_side, center_knot, inertia_label, viscosity_label)
        self.place_in_area(tug_group, 'C1', 'D6', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Updaters for movement
        yellow_side.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_points_as_corners([tug_group.get_left(), center_knot.get_center()]))
        green_side.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_points_as_corners([center_knot.get_center(), tug_group.get_right()]))
        inertia_label.add_updater(lambda m: m.next_to(yellow_side, UP))
        viscosity_label.add_updater(lambda m: m.next_to(green_side, UP))

        self.play(Create(tug_group))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Inertia "wins" - high velocity and scale
        self.play(
            center_knot.animate.shift(RIGHT * 1.2),
            inertia_label.animate.scale(1.5).set_color(YELLOW),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW)
        )

        # Comparison: Whale (High Re) vs Bacteria (Low Re)
        # Create Whale area
        whale = Ellipse(width=1.5, height=0.7, color=BLUE_D, fill_opacity=0.8)
        whale_label = Text("Whale (High Re)", font_size=18).next_to(whale, DOWN)
        
        # Turbulence particles for Whale
        particles = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.03, color=WHITE) for _ in range(20)])
        for p in particles:
            p.move_to(whale.get_right() + np.random.randn(3) * 0.4)
            
        whale_group = VGroup(whale, whale_label, particles)
        self.place_in_area(whale_group, 'E1', 'F3', scale_factor=0.9)
        
        # Create Bacteria area
        bacteria = Dot(radius=0.05, color=WHITE)
        bacteria_label = Text("Bacteria (Low Re)", font_size=18).next_to(bacteria, DOWN)
        honey_rect = Rectangle(width=2, height=1.5, fill_color=GOLD_E, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=0)
        bacteria_group = VGroup(honey_rect, bacteria, bacteria_label)
        self.place_in_area(bacteria_group, 'E4', 'F6', scale_factor=0.9)

        # Simple turbulence animation for whale
        def update_particles(mob, dt):
            for p in mob:
                p.shift(RIGHT * 0.1 * dt + UP * np.sin(self.renderer.time * 5 + p.get_x()) * 0.05)
                if p.get_x() > whale_group.get_right()[0] + 0.5:
                    p.set_x(whale_group.get_center()[0])

        particles.add_updater(update_particles)

        self.play(FadeIn(whale_group), FadeIn(bacteria_group))
        self.wait(3)

        # Cleanup
        self.play(
            FadeOut(re_tex),
            FadeOut(tug_group),
            FadeOut(whale_group),
            FadeOut(bacteria_group),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE)
        )
        self.wait(1)
